notes.title: Filthy, Stinking, Orcs! 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Filthy, Stinking, Orcs! has had several adjustments made to it in order to improve appearance and improve gameplay.

Major Changes
*Updated shaders and textures
*Free to play demo now available on Steam
*Price lowered to $13.99 or equivalent

Minor Changes
*Bugbombs are now slower and do more damage
*Lowered teleporter angle required to exit tower

Near Future
*Current plans are to expand hardware support and add translations.
